title: Ring glow in first person: round 3 (864 G3a, G3b, G3c variations)
desc: You rated 864 G3a, G3b and G3c IMPROVE and picked "3 variations of each": nine new orbit-pixel takes, built differently. Same rules: nothing on the arm, small saturated pixels within 2 px of the face, one pixel per 25% charge, tuck in on Bridge, one direction only.

takes.name: drifting radii
takes.facts: G3a's 4 pixels; each orbit's radius breathes 1.3-2.0 px on its own beat, so they pass each other; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: darting
takes.facts: pixels rest, then dash a quarter lap with an eased hop, each on its own uneven timing; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: wandering loops
takes.facts: each pixel traces its own rose-curve loop (3-7 petals) round the face, never a plain circle; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: comet tails
takes.facts: 2 pixels, each with a 4-pixel tail fading to nothing; tails grow in at 75% and 100%; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: spiral in
takes.facts: 4 tailed pixels spiral in from 2.3 to 1.4 px as the charge fills, then hold; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: stretching tails
takes.facts: lap speed swells and eases; tails stretch when fast, close up when slow; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: three planes
takes.facts: 3 orbits (flat, +-60 degrees), one pixel each; a fourth joins the flat orbit at 100%; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: precessing
takes.facts: 864 G3c's two tilted orbits with the tilt axis turning slowly (one turn per 6 s); 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: atom with a heart
takes.facts: 864 G3c plus a dim pixel at the face's centre that pulses as pixels cross the top; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead
